$comment: Deck slides at 1920 by 1080. Each type's palette (brand/assets/image.json), the words it takes (slots; required ones must be passed), its own words (the brand's address) and the sample copy --sample fills in; the layouts are the engine's (src/assets/deck.ts), built from the share images' rules: the logo top left at the same unit, the headline in Rethink Sans 500 at -0.02em, words kept clear of dots, the dot shader for pictures.
